subject.title: fix(ui): avoid fallback main session parent in Control UI

question: Should Control UI accept bare `/new <name>` and `/label <name>` as session-naming shortcuts, or should naming stay behind `/name` or an explicit named-new syntax?
rationale: The implementation reuses the existing label contract, but it deliberately changes user-facing command grammar that overlaps current `/new [model]` expectations and adjacent session-naming work.

options.title: Accept Control UI Shortcuts
options.body: Land the documented Control UI-only `/new <name>` and `/label <name>` behavior on the existing `label` persistence path.

options.title: Require Explicit Naming Syntax
options.body: Ask the branch to preserve bare `/new` expectations by using `/name`, `/label`, or an explicit `/new --name` form for naming.

options.title: Defer To Broader Naming Work
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want the title migration or broader chat command PR to own named-new semantics across channels.

recommendation.title: Accept Control UI Shortcuts
recommendation.body: Land the documented Control UI-only `/new <name>` and `/label <name>` behavior on the existing `label` persistence path.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the accepted `/name` command direction and were explicitly asked to review this PR's command/session UX choice.
